title: Dental PPO Plans Patient Share on Reprocessed Initial-Wait Lines: Pediatric Out-of-Pocket Limit and Primary Payments
content:
**Rule.** The patient share on a Dental PPO Plans line reprocessed after a denial for the waiting period counted from the coverage effective date (a reprocessed initial-wait line) follows the person and the other coverage:
1. For a person receiving the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment on a line from an in-network practice, the patient share is first limited to the pediatric out-of-pocket room and then reduced by any primary payment recorded on the line. The pediatric out-of-pocket room is the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum for one child less the person's pediatric out-of-pocket postings net of reversals for the benefit year. The plan payment on such a line is the allowance less that limited share, so the line that crosses the pediatric out-of-pocket maximum pays the allowance minus the cost sharing still remaining, and a later line pays the full allowance.
2. For any other line on which a primary payment above 0.00 is recorded, the patient share is reduced by that primary payment.
3. Otherwise the patient share is not adjusted.

The patient share is never below zero.

**Terms.** The pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment applies on an individual exchange enrollment to a date of service before the person's 19th birthday (the pediatric age limit on every Dental PPO plan). An in-network practice is a PPO or Premier in-network practice. The one-child pediatric out-of-pocket maximum is 425.00 on Value 1000 and Plus 1500, and 0.00 on Preventive 750, Classic 1250, Premier 2000 and Elite 2500.

### Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)
| Input | Judgement | Patient share |
|---|---|---|
| Pediatric, in-network, Plus 1500; share before this rule 74.20; net pediatric postings 398.50; no primary payment | Room is 425.00 less 398.50, which is 26.50; the share is limited to 26.50 | 26.50 |
| Pediatric, in-network; share 74.20; net postings 412.10; primary payment 5.00 | Room 12.90; limited to 12.90, then less 5.00 | 7.90 |
| Adult, primary payment 31.75; share 88.40 | Reduced by the primary payment | 56.65 |
| Adult, no primary payment; share 88.40 | Not adjusted | 88.40 |
